question_stem:
A jet of water hits a vertical wall at right angles, as shown in Fig. 3.1.

{{figure:9702_m22_22_q03_figure_3_1}}

Fig. 3.1 (not to scale)

The water hits the vertical wall with a velocity of $5.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in a horizontal direction. The cross-sectional area of the jet is $1.5 \times 10^{-4}\text{ m}^2$. The density of the water is $1.0 \times 10^3\text{ kg m}^{-3}$.

The water runs down the wall after hitting it.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Show that, over a time of $1.6\text{ s}$, the mass of water hitting the wall is $1.2\text{ kg}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: the decrease in the horizontal momentum of the mass of water in (a) due to hitting the wall

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the magnitude of the horizontal force exerted on the water by the wall.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State and explain the magnitude of the horizontal force exerted on the wall by the water.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Calculate the pressure exerted on the wall by the water.
